title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: when two packages ship one name and one declares its .custom override, each package's slot serves its own item (ADR-0150 D4)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoMEcsa8u1Ymjwvb5h8WsfW2)_

Refs #33131 (items 3, 1, 2)

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Skills-docs: none — the platform skill teaches the declared override served at its base's address with no holder order; that was false only for the second-registered of two namespaces shipping one name, and is now true for both.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：两个包发布同一个名字、其中一个包在自己的 `.custom` 里声明了覆盖时，每个包的地址、列表条目和注册表槽位都只返回它自己的那一份（动作、六种封存类型、所有类型的全环境列表）。
- 为什么改：以前动作会跑错包的覆盖体（第一个注册的包的槽位执行了第二个包的覆盖）；第二个包对页面、应用、数据集、文档、书、映射的覆盖在自己地址上不生效，启动报告还让管理员删掉它；全环境列表把覆盖在第一个包名下重复列一次。
- 风险与回滚：只影响"两个已安装包发布同一名字 + 声明覆盖"的组合，工作区内没有这种组合；回滚即还原本 PR，存储数据不变形。
- 先看：`protocol-registry-hydration.ts` 的 `declaredOverrideBaseOf`（第 3 项根因），再看 `protocol-lock-state.ts` 末尾与 `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` 的多发布者过滤。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/protocol-flow-custom-override.test.ts src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts -t 33131`，两种注册顺序全部通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地

## What changes

Two packages of two namespaces (alpha, beta) ship one name; one or both declare an override in their own `.custom` pair (ADR-0150 D4: a declared override binds to the package it names, never to the first-registered shipper).

- **Item 3 — an action ran the wrong body** (`protocol-registry-hydration.ts`). The read-side hydrator registered the pair's override row under the bare name wearing the envelope the artifact lookup answers for the pair's id; the pair ships nothing, so the lookup fell to the first-registered package. The first package's slot then listed, executed and served the second package's override. The new `declaredOverrideBaseOf` gives a bound row the envelope of the base its body declares, only when that base ships the name and `isServedOverrideRowOf` (the one predicate) accepts the row. A package-less row is untouched (epic ruling 6817768147: never a pick between two).
- **Item 1 — the second holder's override of a sealed type did nothing** (`protocol-lock-state.ts`, `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`). `declinesStoredRow` judged a page, app, dataset, doc, book or mapping declaration against the name's first-registered package alone, so the second package's override was declined at its own address (its shipped item served), even with the first package disabled, and the boot census `metadata_sealed_overlay_unserved` told the admin to delete it. Both now judge against every shipper, as a flow and an action already did; the census asks the same question as the door, so the two still agree. Other types keep the owner-only census.
- **Item 2 — the env-wide list misattributed an override** (`protocol-meta-list-reads.ts`). The `flow`/`action` type gate (`TWO_HOLDER_PAIR_SLOT_TYPES`) on the multi-shipper pair-slot filter is gone: for every type, the pair's slot of a declared override is dropped when two or more packages ship the name; a bundle's row only at a member its declared base ships.
- Semantic entry `two-shipper-declared-override-own-slot` (ADR-0087) and two changesets.

## Red lines

1. **Resolution never loosened.** The served row is still judged by `isServedOverrideRowOf` alone (pair binding by column, declaration names the base, overridable type); no new door. Pinned by `CONTROL, alpha/beta registered first: a stranger's row declaring a holder is no override, stays unserved, and the census names it` (six sealed types, both orders).
2. **Ambiguity reported, never guessed.** No answer depends on registration order: every two-holder pin runs both orders, and `… each holder disabled in turn: the enabled holder's own item at its address` / `… the enabled holder's own item alone` show each holder's answer stands alone. The hydrator names only the base the row's own body declares and that ships the name; a package-less row of a two-holder name still wears no envelope.
3. **Independently releasable.** The one-holder answers are unchanged: `CONTROL: one namespace ships the names, with its declared override: its override at its address, and the census names none`, `CONTROL: one package ships the action name, with its declared override: …` and `CONTROL: one package ships the action name, not overridden: …`, plus every pre-existing pin in both files (159/159). Bare-name behaviour of one holder is unchanged. ADR-0087 entry `18.two-shipper-declared-override-own-slot.ts`, `check-adr-0087-registration` green.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-flow-custom-override.test.ts`: new describe `[#33131] two packages ship one action name, one declares an override: each slot serves its own package's item` — both orders × overridden holder, the served and execution lists, the by-name read, the layered `effective`, `registry.getPackageScopedItem`, each holder disabled in turn, and two one-holder CONTROLs. The #32613 mixed pin now asserts the full action list and the other address. The #32552 mapping census pin moves to its TO answer (`…a sealed type's census names neither holder's declared override (a mapping)`, empty census) — an intended move.
- `packages/objectql/src/protocol-custom-override-bare-slot-envelope.test.ts`: new describe `[#33131] two namespaces ship one name, one declares its override: each holder's address serves its own item` over nine types (page, app, dataset, doc, book, mapping, dashboard, report, email_template) — both orders × overridden holder, at once and after a restart, the env-wide list, an empty census; each holder disabled in turn; both overridden; the stranger CONTROL; the one-namespace CONTROL.

Ablations (each with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` + `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`, marker present in dist while mutated, absent after, `git status --porcelain` empty after):

| | mutation | red |
|:--|:--|:--|
| A1 | hydrator envelope back to the pair-id lookup | 4 failed, 6 passed (the item-3 two-holder pins) |
| A2 | sealed branch of `declinesStoredRow` back to owner-only | 6 failed, 7 passed (the item-1 pins) |
| A3 | census per-shipper set back to flow/action | 6 failed, 37 passed (the census pins, both files) |
| A4 | list filter type gate restored | 4 failed, 9 passed (the item-2 list pins) |

## Acceptance notes

- **Items 4 and 5 are not in this PR.** Re-measured on current `origin/main` (protocol sources restored from main, rebuilt): both still reproduce, in both orders. Item 4: `?package=W&member=de-DE` serves `pair de-DE for X` stamped W, W's list and send list carry it, `?package=X` answers 409 naming W, `?package=A.custom` serves it stamped W. Item 5: `?package=X&member=de-DE` serves `pair de-DE` while X's list and send list are `["suitex en-US"]`. Both live in the exact qualifier and the list's member withholding (`pairRowOnAddress`, `pairMemberWithheldAt`), a different fix from items 1–3, so they follow on the card in their own PR. #32606 is therefore not folded here.
- **Item 2 deviation.** The order said fix item 2 only if the env-wide list drops the second holder's override. Measured: it does not drop it; it lists it twice, the extra entry stamped with the first-registered package (`Edited label beta` under `com.probe.alpha` beside `com.probe.beta`) — the same misattribution as item 3, so it is fixed here. Say so if you would rather carry it.
- **Census scope.** The census widening covers flow, action and the six sealed types only; every other type keeps the owner-only judgment it had.
- Declared surface grep (`ruling|Ruling-ref|maintainer|⛔`): 58 hits in 4 of 9 files on `origin/main`. Those beside an edited hunk, each kept: `protocol-registry-hydration.ts` [#32568, epic ruling 6817768147] "⛔ Never a pick between two" (the new arm reads only a bound row's own declared base; a package-less row is untouched) and the `declinesBorrowedEnvelope` "⛔ Those three types…" note (untouched); `protocol-diff-delete-load.ts` "⛔ The question is asked through the DOOR's own predicate" (the census widening mirrors the door's every-shipper judgment); `protocol-meta-list-reads.ts` [epic ruling 6761802819 on #31699] package-less withholding (untouched) and [#28390 ruling A] the bundle rule (kept via `baseServesBundleMember`).

## Verification

Head `dc6cf152` (origin/main merged once, at `28a2f0f5`). All runs under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, `</dev/null`, exit codes recorded first.

- Item 3: alpha first, only beta overridden — lists `alpha:OVR-B` + `beta:OVR-B`; beta first, only alpha overridden — `beta:OVR-A` + `alpha:OVR-A`; with the other holder disabled, `getPackageScopedItem` at the overridden holder answered SHIPPED. 4 failed, 6 passed.
- Item 1: the second holder's override of each sealed type declined at its address, plain and layered (shipped served), with the first holder disabled too; the census named it.
- Item 2: every one of the nine types listed the override twice, the extra entry under the first-registered package.
- After: both harness files 159/159.
